title: AntiLogout
description: A lightweight anti-combat-log plugin for 1.21.x. Features a 20-second BossBar countdown and automatic death penalty for players who logout during combat.
body:
⚔️ About AntyLogout
AntyLogout is a simple, lightweight, and high-performance solution for PvP servers to prevent players from "combat logging" (escaping a fight by logging out). It is fully optimized for the latest Paper and Spigot engines, ensuring smooth gameplay without server lag.
✨ Main Features:
🔴 BossBar System: Every player in combat sees a red bar at the top of their screen with a dynamic countdown (20 seconds).
💀 Combat Punishment: If a player leaves the server while the timer is active, they are automatically killed, and their items drop on the ground.
💬 Chat Notifications: Players receive a message when they enter combat and a green notification when they are safe to log out.
⚡ Zero Configuration: Just drag and drop the plugin into your folder, and it's ready to work!
⚙️ Technical Information:
🎮 Game Version: 1.21.4+
☕ Required Java: 21
🚀 Supported Engines: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
